jou.text: The Satyr springs onto the path and tells Zosimos that his mind's garden is full of weeds and that worry is Phenax's creation, then tells him of the Underworld's coinsmiths and how Erebos equalizes everyone.
He teaches that a true hero is concerned with what he leaves behind, the flowering of goodness, and gives Zosimos a taste of nectarvine sap, telling him the world is good.

The Satyr gives Zosimos a dull, rusty knife and warns that darkness will try to snuff out an awakened hero's light before skipping off into the woods, and the dagger later bursts into heat and light, becoming a shining sword forged by the gods.
